summary.text: Vanessa Poulin is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
She is a U.S. Navy veteran.

paragraphs.text: Vanessa Poulin served in the U.S. Navy from 2012 to 2023, and her career experience includes working as a homemaker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she serves on her town's Budget Committee, Planning Board, and Conservation Commission and is a member of the Belknap-Merrimack Head Start Policy Council.
She listed her campaign's key messages as defending parents' rights, supporting New Hampshire veterans, and stopping out-of-control spending to protect taxpayers.
